series_note: E1-E10 are preserved historical Mac results. They are inspectable on the server, but this catalog does not claim byte-identical Linux rerun portability and does not map any entry to E11.

experiments.title: Baseline exhaustive SfM
experiments.method: Standard SIFT, exhaustive matching, and camera estimation
experiments.camera_policy: Historical camera poses estimated by SfM

experiments.title: Rectangle cleanup of E1
experiments.method: Filter already reconstructed E1 points using multi-view person rectangles
experiments.camera_policy: Reuses E1 cameras; no new feature matching or SfM

experiments.title: Higher-detail guided SfM refinement
experiments.method: Affine/DSP SIFT, selective pairs, guided subset, and new triangulation
experiments.camera_policy: Fixed E1 poses with rescaled intrinsics; not fresh camera estimation
experiments.display_variant: Rectangle-filtered subject preview of the refined sparse model

experiments.title: E3 mask cleanup at 90%
experiments.method: Filter E3 points using Apple Vision person-mask agreement at 90%
experiments.camera_policy: Reuses E3/E1 cameras; no new feature matching or SfM

experiments.title: E3 mask cleanup at 97%
experiments.method: Filter E3 points using stricter Apple Vision person-mask agreement at 97%
experiments.camera_policy: Reuses E3/E1 cameras; no new feature matching or SfM

experiments.title: Higher-detail SfM refinement, guided OFF
experiments.method: E3 features and selective pairs without guided matching, followed by triangulation
experiments.camera_policy: Fixed E1 poses with rescaled intrinsics; not fresh camera estimation
experiments.display_variant: Rectangle-filtered subject preview of the refined sparse model

experiments.title: E6 mask cleanup at 90%
experiments.method: Apply the E4 90% mask policy to E6 points
experiments.camera_policy: Reuses E6/E1 cameras; no new feature matching or SfM

experiments.title: Vocabulary-tree guided SfM refinement
experiments.method: E3 features, top-20 vocabulary retrieval, guided subset, and triangulation
experiments.camera_policy: Fixed E1 poses with rescaled intrinsics; not fresh camera estimation
experiments.display_variant: Rectangle-filtered subject preview of the refined sparse model

experiments.title: E8 mask cleanup at 90%
experiments.method: Apply the E4 90% mask policy to E8 points
experiments.camera_policy: Reuses E8/E1 cameras; no new feature matching or SfM

experiments.title: Exhaustive guided refinement plus 90% cleanup
experiments.method: E3 features, all 7,750 light pairs with guided matching, triangulation, then 90% cleanup
experiments.camera_policy: Fixed E1 poses with rescaled intrinsics; not fresh camera estimation
experiments.display_variant: Published 90%-cleaned output from the E10 reconstruction

dark.reason: E10 was completed for light shirt only; a dark E10 result was never run.
